name: HAKUTO-R Mission 1 (probable impact)

outcomeDetail.summary: After crossing a roughly 3 km crater rim, the lander's software rejected its altitude data. A landing-site change made after critical design review had not been carried into the simulations of the navigation route.

sources.label: ispace, results of the HAKUTO-R Mission 1 lunar landing (26 May 2023)

blurb: A crater rim on an unsimulated route confused the lander's altimetry: a real case of terrain on the approach path mattering.
